gates.evidence: Rear panorama shows one large tree trunk rising above a middle earth plateau, continuous roots exposed below that plateau, and its crown supporting the star-lit upper city. The same carrier can be traced through all tiers.

Three vertically separated tiers are visible: dark chambers among exposed roots at the bottom, an inhabited green earth plateau around the trunk, and luminous buildings among clouds and stars above the crown.

The central woman and open upright coffin both display matching blue cartouches, establishing the intended funerary role. The red anatomical-heart prop itself has no visible matching cartouche, so complete same-owner marking across woman, coffin and weighed heart cannot be verified.
The one brass balance visibly has a red anatomical heart in its left hanging pan and one white feather in its right hanging pan. The beam is horizontal and the pans belong to this same scale.
The tall jackal-headed figure behind the right scale side holds the balance’s central upper plumb/adjustment fitting with one hand; the same balance holds the heart and feather.

location.region: Anubis upper hand and same scale

gates.evidence: The ibis-headed figure holds a visible tablet with a heart-and-feather balance diagram and a reed pen. The writing tip/surface contact is hidden around the tablet’s top edge, so active writing on this record cannot be verified from the native frame.

The one judgment balance is level. Behind the same foreground judgment group, the open bright arch exposes steps leading upward into luminous celestial architecture; it supplies the selected installation’s visible favorable-admission route.

location.region: level beam and open upper-route arch

counts_global_review.evidence: One central woman, one Anubis, one Thoth, and three foreground Fates. Tiny inhabitants inside the scenic realm backdrop are depicted scenery, not additional primary role performers.

supplemental_whole_frame.impression: A rich staged mythic tableau with a still central adult woman, a legible scale judgment group, and a foreground Fate mechanism. The installed-tree idea became a scenic painted/digital panorama rather than a clearly physical sculptural installation.
strengths: Same two-pan heart-feather scale and visible admission arch.
Foreground measuring action and broad tree tier hierarchy.
weaknesses: The three Fate roles read mostly through tools rather than all intended mechanisms.
Spinning, fresh severance, and final same-soul thread ownership are missing.
Thoth’s writing contact and heart’s shared cartouche are not assessable.
